text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"concession to disadvantages followed by rebuttal","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges objections and then explains why the pro position still wins, which makes the argument more persuasive and balanced."},{"evidence":"references who is at fault and initial cost","quality":"argument development","description":"It develops a fuller line of reasoning by addressing specific concerns raised by the topic rather than only listing benefits."},{"evidence":"“should they really be a thing?” and “all in all”","quality":"organizational control","description":"It has a clearer introduction-body-conclusion structure with transitions that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"“would save tons of money ... pay for wrecks, insurance”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It uses details from the article more directly to support claims, rather than relying mostly on broad generalizations."}]}
